يعرنكسوا (form IIIq)
# يَعْرَنْكِسُوا (yaʕrankisū) /jaʕ.ran.ki.suː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
# يُعْرَنْكَسُوا (yuʕrankasū) /juʕ.ran.ka.suː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
